fishingfriend.config.title: Fishing Friend
fishingfriend.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns everything on or off. You can also bind a toggle key in Controls.
fishingfriend.config.bite.tooltip: Plays when a fish bites your bobber (the moment it dips). Reel in right away to catch it.
fishingfriend.config.fished_out.tooltip: Plays when your spot is fished out: you reeled in on time but got nothing, the server said so, or you hit the catch limit.
fishingfriend.config.move_distance.toolt: How far your next spot has to be from a fished-out one. Set this to your server's rule.
fishingfriend.config.catches_per_spot.to: How many catches your server allows in one spot. After that many, the spot counts as fished out. Off if you don't know.
fishingfriend.config.reel_in_message.too: Shows "Reel in now!" above the hotbar when a fish bites.
fishingfriend.config.distance_message.to: After a spot is fished out, shows how much further away you need to cast. Only while you're holding a rod and aiming at (or fishing in) water that's too close.
fishingfriend.config.server_messages.too: Watches server messages about overfishing (like mcMMO's). The phrases can be changed in config/fishingfriend.json.
fishingfriend.config.bobber_warnings.too: Off by default. Shows a message when your bobber lands on the ground, hooks a mob, a fish gets away, or your line snaps.
fishingfriend.config.toggle_key_hint: Bind a toggle key in Options > Controls > Fishing Friend
fishingfriend.message.distance.aim: Overfished here: aim %s more blocks away
fishingfriend.message.distance.aim.one: Overfished here: aim %s more block away
fishingfriend.message.distance.bobber: Bobber is in the overfished spot: recast %s more blocks away
fishingfriend.message.distance.bobber.on: Bobber is in the overfished spot: recast %s more block away
fishingfriend.message.bite_missed: Too slow, the fish got away
fishingfriend.message.landed_on_ground: Your bobber landed on the ground, nothing will bite there
fishingfriend.message.line_snapped: Your line snapped, you moved too far from the bobber
